node.title: Re: POE::Filter::Line seems to be buffering ?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: So it turns out that this can be easily reproduced by comparing the output of udevadm and udevadm | cat on the command line - udevadm is behaving exactly as Perl would when it is [https://perl.plover.com/FAQs/Buffering.html|Suffering from Buffering] (i.e. it's not entirely your program's fault). One fix appears to be adding the option Conduit => 'pty' or Conduit => 'pty-pipe' to the POE::Wheel::Run constructor, I've tested this with your code and it works. From the [mod://POE::Wheel::Run] documentation: "The "pty" conduit type runs the child process under a pseudo-tty, which is created by [mod://IO::Pty]. Pseudo-ttys (ptys) convince child processes that they are interacting with terminals rather than pipes", thus disabling the buffering in udevadm.
